description: Defines interfaces and a template class for synchronous communication channels, including message framing, serialization, deserialization, and state management within the Thunder::Core namespace.

classes.name: IOutbound
classes.description: Interface for outbound messages with serialization and reload capabilities.

classes.name: IInbound
classes.description: Interface for inbound message responses with deserialization and completion status.

classes.name: SynchronousChannelType
classes.description: Template class implementing a synchronous communication channel with message queuing, sending, receiving, and state management.

methods.name: Updated
methods.description: Callback invoked when message status updates.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes message data into a stream.

methods.name: Reload
methods.description: Reloads or resets the message state.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes data from a stream into a message.

methods.name: IsCompleted
methods.description: Checks if inbound message processing is complete.

methods.name: Exchange
methods.description: Sends a message and optionally waits for a response.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Queues a message for sending with optional callback and response.
